info.title: Tasklore API
info.description: REST API of Tasklore. Browsers authenticate with the session cookie; scripts, the CLI and MCP clients with a personal access token (`Authorization: Bearer tl_pat_…`).

get.summary: Show version, runtime and database information
List all users
List all groups with their global permissions

post.summary: Add a user to a group

Sign out and end the current session

Remove a filter from the favourites

get.summary: Liveness: the process is running
Readiness: the database is reachable
List the attachments of an issue

post.summary: Attach a file to an issue
post.description: multipart/form-data with the file in the field `file`; needs the project permission `comment`. The size limit is `attachmentMaxBytes` from /tracking/meta.

delete.summary: Delete an attachment (own, or any as project administrator)

get.summary: Download the content of an attachment
get.description: Verified raster images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) are served inline unless `download=1`; everything else always as a download.

post.description: Requires `edit-issues` on this issue and browse access to the other one.

post.description: Runs a TQL query over the projects the caller can browse. An invalid query answers 400 with `queryErrors` (code, message and position of each error).

get.description: For autocompletion: `value` is the canonical text to put into the query.
